# Step 1: Find the largest residential area sensitive area

SELECT name, area, geometry
FROM sensitive_area
WHERE category = 'RESIDENTIAL_AREA'
ORDER BY area DESC
LIMIT 1
""")
df_area = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(df_area)

query = text(f"""
SELECT id, name_en, ST_Distance(
    coordinate::geography,
    ST_Centroid('{residential_geom}'::geometry)::geography
) as distance
FROM air_quality_station
ORDER BY distance
LIMIT 1
""")
df_station = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
